parts.text: Write a script that assigns a number to a scratchpad variable and includes a comment.

<--start
# Assigning a numeric constant
sv_a = 100.50
print(sv_a)
end-->
Create a script that uses a double-quoted string.

<--start
sv_s = "This is a string literal."
print(sv_s)
end-->
Show me an example of a simple IF/THEN/ELSE conditional block.

<--start
# Using IF, THEN, ELSE, ENDIF keywords
sv_a = 10
if (sv_a > 5) then
  print("Greater than 5")
else
  print("Not greater than 5")
endif
end-->
Create a script with a WHILE/DO loop that iterates 3 times.

<--start
# Using WHILE and DO keywords
lv_c = 0
while (lv_c < 3)
do
  print("Iteration")
  lv_c = lv_c + 1
endwhile
end-->
Generate a script that uses GOTO to jump to a label defined at the end.

<--start
# Using GOTO and a label definition
print("About to jump...")
GOTO end_label
print("This line is skipped.")
end_label:
print("Jumped to the end.")
end-->
Write a script that calls a subroutine with GOSUB and then returns.

<--start
# Using GOSUB and RETURN keywords
GOSUB my_subroutine
EXITSCRIPT

my_subroutine:
  print("Inside the subroutine.")
  RETURN
end-->
Demonstrate how to call an external script named 'process_data.scr'.

<--start
# Using the CALL keyword
print("Calling external script...")
CALL("process_data.scr")
end-->
Create a script that uses the LEFT$ function to extract the first 3 characters of a string.

<--start
# Using a built-in function
sv_a = "Finacle"
sv_b = Left$(sv_a, 3)
print(sv_b)
end-->
How do you call a user-defined routine named 'URTN_CALCULATE_FEE'?

<--start
# Using a user-defined routine name pattern
sv_a = "some_data"
sv_b = URTN_CALCULATE_FEE(sv_a)
print(sv_b)
end-->
Show how to assign a value to a local variable.

<--start
# Using the lv_ variable pattern
lv_a = "This is a local variable."
print(lv_a)
end-->
Write a script that reads from a repository variable.

<--start
# Using the repository variable pattern
sv_a = BANCS.INPUT.userName
print(sv_a)
end-->
Demonstrate the use of an arithmetic operator like multiplication.

<--start
# Using the * arithmetic operator
sv_a = 10
sv_b = 5
sv_c = sv_a * sv_b
print(sv_c)
end-->
Use a comparison operator to check if two variables are not equal.

<--start
# Using the != comparison operator
sv_a = 100
sv_b = 200
if (sv_a != sv_b) then
  print("They are not equal.")
endif
end-->
Create a script with a logical AND operator in the condition.

<--start
# Using the AND logical operator
sv_a = 10
sv_b = "ACTIVE"
if ((sv_a > 5) AND (sv_b == "ACTIVE")) then
  print("Conditions met.")
endif
end-->
Write a script to get the system date and user ID from the repository and print them.

<--start
# Accessing multiple repository variables
sv_a = BANCS.STDIN.sysDate
sv_b = BANCS.STDIN.userId
print("Date: " + sv_a)
print("User: " + sv_b)
end-->
If a local variable lv_a is less than 10 AND greater than 0, print 'Single Digit'.

<--start
# Using multiple comparison operators with AND
lv_a = 7
if ((lv_a < 10) AND (lv_a > 0)) then
  print("Single Digit")
endif
end-->
Create a script that uses a GOSUB to a subroutine which itself contains an IF statement.

<--start
# Complex GOSUB with internal logic
sv_a = "CHECK"
GOSUB validation_routine
EXITSCRIPT

validation_routine:
  if (sv_a == "CHECK") then
    print("Validation in progress.")
  endif
  RETURN
end-->
Take a string, convert it to uppercase, and then extract the first 4 characters.

<--start
# Chaining function concepts: TOUPPER and LEFT$
sv_a = "finacle"
sv_b = TOUPPER(sv_a)
sv_c = Left$(sv_b, 4)
print(sv_c)
end-->
Write a script that turns TRACE ON, performs an addition, and then turns TRACE OFF.

<--start
# Using TRACE ON/OFF keywords
TRACE ON
sv_a = 100 + 200
print(sv_a)
TRACE OFF
end-->
If a variable sv_a equals "A", GOTO label_a. If it equals "B", GOTO label_b.

<--start
# Multiple GOTO statements from different conditions
sv_a = "B"
if (sv_a == "A") then
  GOTO label_a
endif
if (sv_a == "B") then
  GOTO label_b
endif
EXITSCRIPT

label_a:
  print("In section A.")
  EXITSCRIPT
label_b:
  print("In section B.")
  EXITSCRIPT
end-->
Use the CINT function to convert a string "50" to a number before performing an arithmetic operation.

<--start
# Using a conversion function with an operator
sv_a = "50"
sv_b = CINT(sv_a)
sv_c = sv_b * 2
print(sv_c)
end-->
Check if either a local variable lv_a is "Y" OR a scratchpad variable sv_b is "Y".

<--start
# Using the OR logical operator with different variable types
lv_a = "N"
sv_b = "Y"
if ((lv_a == "Y") OR (sv_b == "Y")) then
  print("At least one condition is met.")
endif
end-->
Demonstrate a nested loop structure.

<--start
# Nested WHILE/DO loops
lv_a = 0
while (lv_a < 2)
do
  lv_b = 0
  while (lv_b < 3)
  do
    print("Inner loop")
    lv_b = lv_b + 1
  endwhile
  print("Outer loop")
  lv_a = lv_a + 1
endwhile
end-->
Define a label and have a GOTO jump to it from within an IF block.

<--start
sv_a = 100
if (sv_a == 100) then
  print("Value is 100, jumping...")
  GOTO my_label
endif
print("This should be skipped.")
my_label:
print("Execution continues here.")
end-->
